summary: tailwindcss-hide-scrollbar ships obfuscated load-time RCE payload with Ethereum RPC beacons
details: The package's declared main dist/index.js exports a small Tailwind scrollbar-hide plugin and then executes eval(atob('...')) on a large obfuscator.io-style payload every time the module is required or imported. The decoded payload uses dynamic require of http, https, zlib, and child_process to run arbitrary Node code in the installer's process at library-load time. Decoded strings show the payload reads process.env.ETH_RPC_URL and issues Ethereum JSON-RPC / block-explorer requests (eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_blockNumber, account/transaction queries) against hardcoded hosts including drpc.org, publicnode, and blockscout-style endpoints — wallet-monitoring/drainer beacon behavior with no relationship to a CSS plugin. The obfuscation (hex-name identifiers, shuffled string array with rotate loop, hex-arithmetic index lookup) is applied only to the network + child_process path, layered onto an otherwise trivial 20-line plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
